counterfactual_missing_items: specific diagnostic features distinguishing among the top candidates
decisive_items: large, crusted, erythematous plaque on the right chest
response.rationale: All candidates except R2 share the same raw support span describing the plaque. R1 and R3 have nearly identical generator assessments and raw evidence, with R3 adding a redundant shorter span. No raw contradictions exist for any candidate. The margin is low because the raw evidence does not differentiate among R1, R3, and R4; R1 is chosen as champion based on the completeness of its generator assessments and typicality, while R3 is a close runner-up. R2 lacks any raw support and is rejected.

rejected.why: No raw support spans; only non-raw generator assessments.
Raw support identical to R1 and R3, but generator assessments are less aligned with the chronic inflammatory pattern suggested by the treatment history.
